purpose: Quantify sensitivity of the accepted project-defined H2 teacher path to the Eq.11.20 mixing-length constant without changing any other physical or numerical control.

varied_parameter.name: C_m
varied_parameter.source_role: The admissible range is teacher-source-backed; the discrete study sampling design is project-defined.

grid_design.claim_boundary: Two grids do not establish asymptotic grid independence or a formal GCI result.

frozen_controls.policy: All baseline physical inputs and numerical controls other than C_m remain frozen to the accepted project-defined H2 path.

acceptance_policy.project_mass_inventory_QA: 0.5% inlet-scale threshold; project-defined, not a literature/teacher universal threshold
